PHASE.NAME: RTK-Style Command Router Upgrade
PHASE.GOAL: Bring Synapse token savings closer to RTK scale with command routing, wider adapters, OpenCode autoproxy coverage, and session/adapter analytics.

STEPS.step-1: Added RTK-style command router with adapter catalogue and route decisions.
STEPS.step-2: Connected proxy execution to router metadata and adapter-aware tracking.
STEPS.step-3: Expanded built-in filters for pytest, uv, ruff, mypy, rg, gh/glab, docker compose/logs, kubectl, terraform/tofu, helm, just, bun, deno, and journalctl.
STEPS.step-4: Added adapter, route_key, and session_id tracking with migration-safe SQLite schema updates.
STEPS.step-5: Added syn proxy --route preview plus syn gain --sessions/--adapters analytics.
STEPS.step-6: Expanded OpenCode plugin and shell hook autoproxy coverage with stable SYNAPSE_SESSION_ID propagation.
